t2.thesis: FOUR reports into a heavily de-rated, high-short-interest setup with a large implied move (~17.6%), but the symmetric payoff, prior guide-cut, and falling estimates leave the edge near the base rate.
reasons: Stock is down ~39% over 12m and 43% below its 52w high, with a forward P/E near 7; expectations are low, which supports a relief bounce.
Short interest is ~18% of float, so a modest beat could squeeze.
Estimates were cut ~16% over 90 days after the August guide-down, and the prior BMO print fell 15% despite an EPS beat; guidance credibility is the risk.
Stock rallied ~11% in the last 5 days into the print, which takes away some of the cheap-entry cushion.
Past 4 reactions were 2 up and 2 down with huge magnitudes, so the implied move is not informative about direction.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 guidance for full-year GRLNF and adjusted EPS (whether the lowered August range holds) and the Global Blue integration and margin progress.

prior.from: BMO session base rate (I3, 54.8%), close to overall validation 54.2%; software_internet cluster 54.1%

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-11-03, so the 2026-11-05 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how FOUR's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered about 3 points from 0.548 to 0.52 because of the recent run-up, prior guide-cut and negative revisions, partly offset by low valuation and high short interest.

theses.expected: Rise: results meet or beat and the lowered guide is reaffirmed or nudged up
theses.mechanism: Low bar, 7x forward P/E and 18% short interest produce a relief rally and short covering
theses.wrong_if: Guidance is cut again or organic growth decelerates

theses.expected: Fall: another guidance trim or margin pressure from Global Blue and higher interest expense
theses.mechanism: Estimates are already declining and the pre-print run-up leaves room to give back gains
theses.wrong_if: Management reaffirms guidance with improving free cash flow conversion

theses.expected: Muted or mixed open: in-line print with offsetting signals
theses.mechanism: Much of the bad news was priced in after the 27% drop in August
theses.wrong_if: A decisive surprise in either direction moves the open by more than 10%

key_observations: FY2026 GRLNF and adjusted EPS guidance versus the lowered ranges ($2.48-2.53B, $5.15-5.35)
Adjusted free cash flow conversion and leverage/interest expense
Global Blue TFS revenue trajectory and synergies
Commentary on the pending account-to-account payments acquisition
